en.title: Terms & Conditions
en.introduction: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of services provided by Elite Special Solutions, a professional consultancy specializing in automation, client engagement, and operational support. By engaging in our services, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined below.

sections.title: Scope of Services
intro: Elite Special Solutions provides tailored business support and operational infrastructure designed to empower teams, optimize workflows, and elevate client engagement. Our services span multiple verticals and are delivered with precision, professionalism, and bilingual fluency.
items: A. Operational Design & Automation — Custom workflow automation using platforms such as Zapier, Power Automate, and Google Workspace; CRM integration and optimization (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive); SOP development for scalable team operations and properly filled positions; onboarding systems and access matrices for remote teams and collaborators.

B. Customer Service & Retention — Bilingual customer support agents trained in empathy, escalation handling, and CRM logging; retention strategies including proactive outreach, loyalty scripting, and feedback loops; call tracking and coaching systems for quality assurance and performance improvement.

C. Sales Enablement & Cold Calling — Lead generation and qualification workflows; cold calling campaigns with disposition tracking and tagging; sales funnel design and automation; coaching dashboards for live supervision, whisper feedback, and call review.

D. Collections & Follow-Up Systems — Structured follow-up sequences for past-due accounts; bilingual collection agents trained in diplomacy and compliance; integration with payment platforms and CRM for real-time updates; custom outcome tagging (e.g., “Promise to Pay,” “Dispute,” “Escalated”).

E. Virtual Assistant Services — Administrative support including calendar management, inbox triage, and document preparation; bilingual communication and transcription; task tracking and reporting via shared dashboards; specialized VA roles for sales, customer care, and executive support.

F. Communication Infrastructure — Branded email signatures, auto-replies, and message templates; virtual number setup and call routing (e.g., OpenPhone, CloudTalk); SMS/MMS workflows and WhatsApp integration; area code mapping and localization for U.S.–Nicaragua operations.

G. Strategic Consulting — Branding and messaging refinement for bilingual audiences; logistics mapping for canvassing, delivery, or service zones; payment system evaluation and integration (e.g., PayPal, Wise, local banks); legal policy drafting for compliance and transparency, including Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Service Engagement & Deliverables
items: Services commence upon written agreement of scope, pricing, and timelines.
Deliverables may include digital assets, dashboards, SOPs, or integrations.
Revisions are limited to those specified in the proposal; additional requests may incur fees.
Elite Special Solutions reserves the right to use subcontractors when necessary, ensuring equal quality and confidentiality standards.

sections.title: Payment Terms
items: Invoices are issued at project initiation, milestone completion, or as otherwise agreed.
Standard payment terms: Net 2–7 days.
Accepted payment methods: bank transfer, PayPal, or approved local platforms.
Late payments: 5% administrative fee after a 5-day grace period.
Services may be suspended for overdue balances.

sections.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
items: Written cancellations are required 72 hours before project start.
Refunds are available only for unrendered services and are subject to a 10% processing fee.
No refunds are available for completed services, digital assets, or time-based consulting.
Prepaid retainers are non-refundable but may be applied toward future services at Elite Special Solutions’ discretion.

sections.title: Confidentiality & Data Protection
items: All client information, strategies, and communications are strictly confidential.
Elite Special Solutions complies with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR where relevant.
Data is never shared, sold, or repurposed without explicit written consent.
Clients are responsible for ensuring they have proper rights to any third-party data shared with us.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
items: All deliverables remain the property of Elite Special Solutions until full payment is received.
Upon payment, clients receive a non-exclusive, non-transferable license for internal business use.
Resale, redistribution, or public disclosure of deliverables requires prior written consent.
Elite Special Solutions may showcase non-sensitive deliverables in portfolios or case studies unless otherwise agreed in writing.

sections.title: Liability & Limitations
items: Services are provided in good faith and with professional diligence.
Elite Special Solutions is not liable for indirect losses, third-party platform failures, or client misuse of deliverables.
Maximum liability is limited to the total fees paid for the specific service in dispute.
No guarantees are made regarding sales outcomes, revenue generation, or client retention, as results depend on multiple external factors.

sections.title: Client Responsibilities
items: Provide accurate, timely information and access to platforms.
Respond to requests for feedback or approvals within agreed timelines.
Delays or incomplete inputs may extend deadlines or increase costs.
Clients are responsible for compliance with all applicable laws when using deliverables.

sections.title: Communication Protocol
items: Official communication takes place via email or approved messaging platforms.
Standard response times vary based on service tier and business hours.
Expedited or emergency support may incur additional fees.

sections.title: Force Majeure
intro: Elite Special Solutions is not responsible for delays or failures caused by events beyond its control, including but not limited to natural disasters, internet outages, platform downtime, political unrest, or labor disputes.

sections.title: Jurisdiction & Governing Law
items: These Terms are governed by the laws of Nicaragua.
Any disputes shall be resolved exclusively in the competent courts of Nicaragua.
Before legal proceedings, both parties agree to attempt mediation or good-faith negotiation.

sections.title: Modifications
intro: Elite Special Solutions reserves the right to update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Clients will be notified of significant changes via email or official website updates. Continued use of services after notification constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

es.title: Términos y condiciones
es.introduction: Estos Términos y condiciones regulan el uso de los servicios prestados por Elite Special Solutions, una consultora profesional especializada en automatización, atención al cliente y apoyo operativo. Al contratar o utilizar nuestros servicios, reconoces y aceptas los términos que se indican a continuación.

sections.title: Alcance de los servicios
intro: Elite Special Solutions ofrece apoyo empresarial e infraestructura operativa personalizados para impulsar equipos, optimizar flujos de trabajo y mejorar la atención al cliente. Nuestros servicios abarcan distintos sectores y se prestan con precisión, profesionalismo y capacidad bilingüe.
items: A. Diseño operativo y automatización — Automatización personalizada de flujos de trabajo con plataformas como Zapier, Power Automate y Google Workspace; integración y optimización de CRM (por ejemplo, HubSpot, Zoho y Pipedrive); desarrollo de procedimientos operativos estándar para equipos escalables y puestos debidamente cubiertos; sistemas de incorporación y matrices de acceso para equipos remotos y colaboradores.

B. Servicio al cliente y retención — Agentes bilingües capacitados en empatía, gestión de escalaciones y registro en CRM; estrategias de retención con contacto proactivo, guiones de fidelización y ciclos de retroalimentación; seguimiento y capacitación de llamadas para asegurar la calidad y mejorar el rendimiento.

C. Apoyo de ventas y llamadas en frío — Flujos de generación y calificación de prospectos; campañas de llamadas en frío con seguimiento y clasificación de resultados; diseño y automatización de embudos de ventas; paneles de capacitación para supervisión en vivo, asesoría durante llamadas y revisión de llamadas.

D. Cobranzas y seguimiento — Secuencias estructuradas de seguimiento de cuentas vencidas; agentes bilingües de cobranza capacitados en diplomacia y cumplimiento; integración con plataformas de pago y CRM para actualizaciones en tiempo real; clasificación personalizada de resultados (por ejemplo, “Promesa de pago”, “Disputa” y “Escalado”).

E. Servicios de asistencia virtual — Apoyo administrativo que incluye gestión de calendarios, clasificación de bandejas de entrada y preparación de documentos; comunicación y transcripción bilingües; seguimiento de tareas e informes mediante paneles compartidos; funciones especializadas de asistencia virtual para ventas, atención al cliente y apoyo ejecutivo.

F. Infraestructura de comunicación — Firmas de correo con marca, respuestas automáticas y plantillas de mensajes; configuración de números virtuales y enrutamiento de llamadas (por ejemplo, OpenPhone y CloudTalk); flujos de SMS/MMS e integración con WhatsApp; asignación de códigos de área y localización para operaciones entre Estados Unidos y Nicaragua.

G. Consultoría estratégica — Ajuste de marca y mensajes para audiencias bilingües; planificación logística de zonas de promoción, entrega o servicio; evaluación e integración de sistemas de pago (por ejemplo, PayPal, Wise y bancos locales); elaboración de políticas legales para cumplimiento y transparencia, incluidos los Términos y condiciones y el Aviso de privacidad.
